description:
A map keyed by a tuple or a list never matches on lookup, on all three doors.

  tup = %{{:x, 1} => :tuple_key}
  tup[{:x, 1}]      elixir :tuple_key    fz interp/run/build nil

  lk = %{[1, 2] => :listkey}
  lk[[1, 2]]        elixir :listkey      fz interp/run/build nil

The map RENDERS correctly (`%{{:x, 1} => :tuple_key}`), so construction is fine
and it is the lookup that fails. Binary and integer keys look up correctly
(integers modulo the separate panic ticket). The doors agree with each other and
disagree with the oracle, so this is one implementation being wrong rather than
a divergence.

Pre-existing; found while reviewing fz-5xp.4. Compound keys are ordinary in
Elixir and this epic adds a real `Map` (fz-5xp.12), so the lookup path needs to
handle a heap-allocated key by structural identity, not by raw word.
title: Map lookup never matches a tuple or list key
